name.ja: BB戦士 LEGENDBB 新世大将軍
name.en: BB Senshi LEGENDBB New World General

ja: この烈光頑駄無こそ新世代の大将軍
その 名 も 新 世 大 将 軍 な り !!
「伝説の大将軍編」の大将軍である新世大将軍が、
メッキ・クリアパーツ等をふんだんに用いた豪華絢爛な仕様で、待望のLEGENDBB化！
特典限定カードダスが２枚必ずもらえる！
●　新規造形で形状を徹底再現！
新世大将軍本体には完全新規造形のボディを採用！
大将軍の鎧にも新規造形パーツを採用し、LEGENDBB準拠のクオリティで立体化！
●　金メッキを採用した、豪華仕様！
特徴的な兜の「心凰」と両肩の「技凰」、「体凰」をはじめ、
兜・前立て・両肩・足・軍配・剣など、各所に金メッキをふんだんに採用！
●　クリアパーツを用いた色分け再現！！
「太陽砲発射形態」で使用する頭部の結晶風防＜クリスタルゴーグル＞や輝煌の軍配、
本体各所の頑駄無結晶をクリアパーツを採用し再現！
●　大将軍専用の各種武装が付属！
「光鳳剣」、「戦武面」、「神手甲」、軽装タイプの角飾りが取り付け可能な「輝煌の軍配」が付属。
背部の大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞は変形ギミックを搭載。
大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞
両手持ちの大砲＝三連大目牙砲＜トリプルオメガキャノン＞に変形が可能！
●　神馬凰形態・太陽砲発射形態へ変形!!
「鬼神の如くみなぎる力」、「天馬の如く駆ける脚」、 「鳳凰の如く舞う翼」
これら全てを兼ね備えた究極の戦闘形態「神馬凰形態」への変形を再現 !
太陽砲発射形態
さらに、「神馬凰形態」から必殺の「太陽砲発射形態」へと変形可能！
●　LEGENDBB 飛駆鳥大将軍と超連動！
LEGENDBB 飛駆鳥大将軍への翼の取り付けが可能。
さらにLEGENDBBオリジナルの新ギミックとして、翼と大目牙撃砲＜オメガスマッシャー＞も飛駆鳥大将軍に装備が可能に！
飛駆鳥大将軍が”神馬凰形態”へと超パワーアップ!!
●　今石進氏による新規書き起こしイラストを贅沢に使用した、豪華フルカラーパッケージ!
取扱説明書には新作コミックワールドを掲載！

en: This Rekko Gundam u is the new generation of great generals.
His name is New World General!
The new Taishogun of the "Legendary Taishogun Edition",
The long-awaited LEGENDBB version with gorgeous specifications using plenty of plating and clear parts!
You will definitely get 2 bonus limited edition Carddass!
● Thoroughly reproduce the shape with new modeling!
The new Taishogun body has a completely new body shape!
New molding parts are also used for the general's armor, making it three-dimensional with LEGENDBB compliant quality!
● Luxury specification with gold plating!
Including the characteristic "Shinou " on the helmet, " Technical " and " Taiou" on both shoulders,
Plenty of gold plating is used in various parts such as the helmet, placket, shoulders, legs, military armor, and sword!
● Color-coded reproduction using clear parts! !
The crystal windshield <crystal goggles> on the head used in the "solar cannon firing mode" and the glittering armor,
Reproduce the Gundam crystals in various parts of the main body using clear parts!
● Includes various weapons for the general!
Comes with a "Kouhou Sword ", " Battle Mask ", " God Gauntlet ", and a " Shining Gunbai" to which light armor type horn ornaments can be attached.
The large fang gun on the back <Omega Smasher> is equipped with a deformation gimmick.
Omega Smasher
Can transform into a two-handed cannon = Triple Omega Cannon!
● Transforms into Shinmaou form and solar cannon firing form!!
"Power that overflows like a demon god ", " legs that run like a heavenly horse ", " wings that dance like a phoenix"
Reproduce the transformation into the ultimate battle form "Shinbaou form" that combines all of these!
Solar cannon firing form
Furthermore, it can transform from its "Shinbaou form " to its deadly " solar cannon firing form"!
● LEGENDBB Super linked with Asukatou Daishogun!
Wings can be attached to the LEGENDBB Asukacho Taishogun.
Furthermore, as a new gimmick original to LEGENDBB, wings and a large-eyed fang cannon <Omega Smasher> can also be equipped on the Asukacho Daishogun!
General Asukatou super powers up to “Shinbaou form”!!
● Luxurious full-color package that uses newly transcribed illustrations by Susumu Imaishi!
The new comic world is posted in the handling manual!
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
